audit_scope.description: EIP-7892 spans both EL (timestamp-based activation, blob gas computation) and CL (epoch-based activation, fork digest rotation). EIP-7883 is EL-only (ModExp precompile gas repricing). EIP-8123 is JSON-RPC (out of scope per bug bounty).

in_scope: P2P Network (fork digest rotation, ENR updates)

out_of_scope_reasons.JSON-RPC API: Explicitly out-of-scope per Ethereum Bug Bounty: vulnerabilities requiring publicly exposed API
out_of_scope_reasons.Beacon API: Explicitly out-of-scope per Ethereum Bug Bounty: vulnerabilities requiring publicly exposed API
out_of_scope_reasons.Configuration: Requires node operator error, not external attack
out_of_scope_reasons.ERC-20 contracts: Not included in Ethereum Bug Bounty scope
out_of_scope_reasons.ENS: Maintained by ENS foundation, separate scope

misclassified_entities.reason: EIP-8123 models a JSON-RPC method (eth_txGasLimitCap). The 'RPC Node' is the system under audit itself, not an external entity. Furthermore, JSON-RPC API is explicitly out-of-scope for the bug bounty.
User via JSON-RPC is out-of-scope per bug bounty (vulnerabilities requiring publicly exposed JSON-RPC API are excluded). Entity is valid as an external entity but the attack surface is out of scope.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node via P2P Network
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P gossip topics (fork digest subscription, ENR discovery)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers are unauthenticated. Any node can join the network and send arbitrary protocol messages including malformed ENR records or subscribe to stale fork digest topics. All P2P input must be fully validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: EVM Caller via On-chain Transaction
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: ModExp precompile call (address 0x05) via transaction execution
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any smart contract or EOA can invoke the ModExp precompile with arbitrary input data. Calldata is fully attacker-controlled. The gas pricing formula must accurately reflect computational cost to prevent DoS.

trusted_external_entities.name: Consensus Layer via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Engine API (newPayload, forkchoiceUpdated) - blob parameter validation during BPO fork transitions
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT. CL drives EL fork activation via Engine API calls. However, if CL and EL have misaligned blob schedules (EIP-7892 assumption), corrupted parameters could propagate. Content must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Validator via P2P Network
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Archetypal top-down threat: a malicious validator can propose blocks with crafted blob parameters at BPO fork boundaries, or submit conflicting attestations. All validator messages must be validated against consensus rules.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P ENR discovery and gossip topic subscription
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Node must validate peer ENR fork digest values. Peers advertising stale or invalid fork digests after BPO activation must be handled gracefully (disconnected or ignored). Gossip messages on old fork digest topics must be rejected after transition.

Gas pricing formula must accurately price all input combinations. Attacker-crafted inputs (large exponents, adversarial base/modulus sizes) must not achieve computation-to-gas ratios that enable DoS. The 16x iteration multiplier and minimum floor of 500 gas must hold for worst-case inputs.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Engine API fork activation and blob parameter updates
boundary_edges.security_assumption: EL must validate that blob schedule parameters received via Engine API calls are consistent with its own configuration. Misaligned target/max blob counts between CL and EL could cause valid blocks on one layer to be rejected on the other, leading to chain splits.

Blocks proposed at BPO fork boundaries must be validated against the correct blob parameter set for their slot/epoch. Attestations referencing blocks with incorrect blob counts must be rejected. Fork choice must handle the transition correctly.
